q.line: Never think I took you for granted
stanza: Dear Florence-Jean
The future is a drag
I have to get back to my planet
I hate to let you down
Before the sun goes out
Never think I took you for granted

partner.line: I have to get back to my planet

stanza: How many encounters do you ever have-
Better yet, how many wolves you ever seen?
You got about as much chance of seeing one of them
As you do running into me
Still, take nothing for granted
Might live on the best block in Beverly Hills
Be sure you lock up tight at night
'Cause you know poor folks ain't got nothing to steal

partner.line: How many encounters do you ever have-

q.line: Even though you take my love for granted
stanza: Even though you take my love for granted
I'm pretty strong when I admit it
You might be surprised at what I can manage
But don't you ever forget

partner.line: You might be surprised at what I can manage

q.line: Outside your iron gates with one wish granted
stanza: The fat woman frowns
At screaming frightened clowns that move enchanted
And the shadow lion waits
Outside your iron gates with one wish granted
Colors fall, throw the ball
Play the game of Carnival

partner.line: At screaming frightened clowns that move enchanted
